blocks.title: USB Restriction Methods
blocks.body:
# Restricting Android USB Port to Charging Only

## Quick visual

![USB port modes](/media/diagrams/usb-modes.svg)

Choose the restriction method that matches your fleet: ADB command, MDM policy, rooted settings, or hardware.

Overview of methods to prevent USB data transfer while allowing charging.

## 1. Developer Options (Manual)
1. Settings > About phone > tap Build number seven times.
2. Settings > Developer options > Default USB configuration > Charging only.
Note: users can override this manually.

## 2. Enterprise MDM
Use MDM platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Intune, AirWatch, or MobileIron.
1. Choose an MDM solution.
2. Create a USB restriction policy.
3. Deploy the policy to managed devices.

## 3. Custom ROM / Rooted Device
Advanced only. Use Tasker with root, or modify ROM source to remove USB data transfer. Risk of warranty void / bricking.

## 4. Charge-Only Cables
Hardware cables without data lines physically block transfer while allowing charge.

## Conclusion
- Personal use: Developer Options
- Organizations: MDM
- Deep control: Custom ROM/root
- Guaranteed physical block: charge-only cable

## Resources
